description: Moviemaking teaches visual storytelling: the elements of a good film, writing a treatment and storyboard, camera techniques, producing a short film, visiting a set or learning lenses, and careers or hobbies in film.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Elements of a good film
requirements.summary: Visual storytelling, rhythm, the 180-degree rule, camera movement, framing and lenses.

requirements.title: Making a film
requirements.summary: A treatment, a storyboard, key shooting techniques and one film project.

requirements.title: A set visit or lenses
requirements.summary: One option: visiting a film set or studio, or explaining how a zoom lens works.

requirements.title: Careers or hobbies
requirements.summary: One option: a film career, or a hobby that uses these skills.
